summary: tools/agent-eval now parses its flags with the brief's refusals in order, reads cases (prompt.md and graders/*.md frontmatter by hand) and implements --list.
verified: vloop task gate T1 exited 0 and printed 'gate T1: ok'; go test, vet, gofmt, windows build clean.
notes: Without --list, after refusals and reading cases the tool prints 'agent-eval: running cases is not built yet' and exits 1; T2 replaces that. --list skips the agent/model/out/runs/timeout refusals but still refuses 'no case matches'. Double-quoted values are kept as written inside the quotes (no unescaping). A prompt.md with no frontmatter is read as all body; graders must have closed frontmatter.
